title: SpecForge: Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents via Behavioral Specifications
abstract: arXiv:2610.15708v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents based on frozen language models can improve their performance by refining the external context they rely on, without updating model weights. We study recursive self-improvement through behavioral specifications: natural-language code documentation that describes the behavior of program entities and guides agents in generating correct code. We formulate a self-improvement loop in which an agent generates code from its current specifications, evaluates it with execution-verified tests, and refines the specifications based on observed failures. The improved specifications then guide subsequent generation, progressively improving the agent's understanding of the codebase. However, recursive refinement is challenging because program entities are interdependent. translated_title: SpecForge：基于行为规范的编码代理递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 基于冻结语言模型的编码代理可以通过优化其所依赖的外部上下文来提升性能，而无需更新模型权重。我们研究了通过行为规范实现的递归自我改进：行为规范是描述程序实体行为的自然语言代码文档，可引导代理生成正确的代码。我们构建了一个自我改进循环：代理根据当前规范生成代码，通过经过执行验证的测试进行评估，并根据观察到的失败来修正规范。改进后的规范随后指导后续的代码生成，逐步提升代理对代码库的理解。然而，递归改进具有挑战性，因为程序实体之间相互依赖——改进某个实体的规范可能会无意中降低其他实体的正确性，我们将这种现象称为“输出耦合”。这会产生一种“打地鼠”效应……
tldr: 该论文提出SpecForge框架，通过“根据行为规范生成代码—执行测试验证—依据失败修正规范”的递归自我改进循环，使冻结语言模型的编码代理无需更新权重即可持续提升代码生成能力，并揭示了规范改进中因程序实体相互依赖而产生的“输出耦合”难题。
en_tdlr: SpecForge enables frozen-LM coding agents to recursively self-improve through a generate-test-refine loop over behavioral specifications, while identifying the "output coupling" problem where refining one entity's specification inadvertently degrades others' correctness.
